patterns.seam: alln serve LaunchAgent → ToolRuntime → catalog load → SwiftPM resource-bundle accessor fallback Bundle(path: bake)
patterns.law: Production code must not call the SwiftPM resource-bundle accessor. SPM sidecar directories often have no Info.plist, so Bundle(path:) is nil and the compile-time fallback stats ~/Documents (TCC). Read sidecar files. Relocate-proof must run a command that loads the catalog (`menu --json`), not `version`. strings must not contain Documents/GitHub or /Users/.../Documents/.

patterns.seam: AppDelegate / capacity re-arm / strip loadLive / remote bootstrap → vendor CLI or bash spawn under Dock TCC identity
patterns.law: Mac cold launch is process-quiet before explicit Setup / Refresh / Enable / Run / sign-in. Capacity default-ON re-arms the 30m scheduler only (no immediate `.launch` wave). Strip `loadLive` paints placeholders only. Dock app must not ServeAutoLaunch. Persisted remote session is not consent to spawn relay. Native capacity headless spawns use ProbeScratch CWD.
patterns.proof: scripts/swift-test.sh --filter 'CapacityFeatureOffTests|ServeAutoLaunchTests/testMacAppLaunchDoesNotDemandHealServe'; Mac AppModelTests capacity/remote source gates

patterns.seam: ServeAutoLaunch executable resolution → Process spawn → Mac @main
patterns.law: ServeAutoLaunch must never exec a path under `.app/Contents/MacOS/`. Prefer the running CLI binary, then staged ServeStableBinary, then `alln` on PATH; fail closed otherwise. The Dock app must not call ensureRunning on launch, and must exit without activating when argv is `serve`.

patterns.seam: AppKit NSTextView pasteboard handling below the SwiftUI composer bridge
patterns.law: The Mac composer text view must own plain-text paste insertion directly; do not close a paste bug by relying only on SwiftUI commands, a main Edit menu, or implicit AppKit responder routing.

patterns.seam: AppKit pasteboard/responder chain -> SwiftUI composer state -> attachment chip -> worker context delivery
patterns.law: Image paste is not fixed by proving any one layer. Proof must traverse copied image/file URL -> focused composer paste gesture -> visible attachment chip -> SwiftUI state preserved -> send includes the attachment in worker context. If this recurs, build an isolation harness that mirrors the AppKit/SwiftUI seam before patching product code.
patterns.proof: Harness record plus targeted app tests: ComposerPasteboardReaderTests for image-first pasteboard precedence, focused composer paste/attachment integration for chip creation, and TeamRunAttachmentDeliveryTests for worker-context delivery.

patterns.seam: Any native/platform/product boundary where the full proof is not writable inside the current product path
patterns.law: When a repeated bug depends on native/platform behavior, stop in-place patching after two failed fixes and build a throwaway isolation harness that proves the primitive and seam before porting the delta back.
patterns.proof: Debugger packet must name `Attempt count`, `Seam`, `Isolation harness`, and the harness-to-product delta; future wall gate should fail repeated DEBUGLOG entries that omit them.

patterns.seam: Xcode Archive source worktree -> submitted TestFlight build
patterns.law: A TestFlight launch fix is not done until the exact worktree/project path being archived contains the fallback fix and does not contain the old onboarding strings. Do not prove this only in another git worktree.
patterns.proof: git grep -n 'Control your Mac from anywhere\|Sign in to see your Macs and control team runs from anywhere\|isTestFlightReceipt' HEAD -- Apps/AllnighteriOS must return no app-source matches in the worktree used for Xcode Archive.

patterns.seam: Release launch fallback after live remote credentials are unavailable
patterns.law: Until remote sign-in is actually wired, any unauthenticated Release build must enter the supported dogfood preview/home path, not the dead sign-in/onboarding wall. Do not close this by clearing DerivedData, changing target selection, bumping the build number, or relying on App Store receipt filename alone; prove the release fallback policy.

patterns.seam: AgentOS TeamAnswer transitions -> Panel journal -> CLI status/watch
patterns.law: A parallel Panel must durably project every seat transition and terminal error reason as it arrives. An unfinished seat is `running`, never `empty`; batch completion may settle the round but must not be the first time fast failures become visible.

patterns.seam: host process authority -> optional transport -> RunService.run -> worker process -> canonical registered repository
patterns.law: A bug fix cannot introduce a mirror, clone, snapshot, scratch checkout, alternate-root request field, second run-semantics owner, permission workaround, fallback, compatibility bridge, or new resident operation. Those are Founder Architecture Stops requiring a separate feature packet.
patterns.proof: Planned in CODE_RED_Core_Infrastructure_Repair.md: bash scripts/check_architecture_policy.sh plus bash scripts/code_red_works_test.sh live-direct; remains on REGRESSION_LAW_BACKLOG.md until both are wall-reachable.
